'''GrrKack''' was an [[Ugor/Legends|Ugor]] [[Tax Chaplain]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He operated from the [[Paradise system/Legends|Paradise system]] and greeted anyone who visited in search of ancient pieces of salvage from the system-spanning junkyard. Backed by two Ugor [[Tax Enforcer]]s, the Tax Chaplain escorted pilgrims to the ship of the [[Chief Tax Chaplain]], [[ArrGack]]. GrrKack was responsible for alerting pilgrims to the [[High Ugorian Law]] in effect in the Paradise system. He and his superior officer, ArrGack, were open to bribes for exemptions to certain of these stipulations.<ref name="SH" />

GrrKack wore a suit of [[Rhodium/Legends|rhodium]]-plated combat [[Armor/Legends|armor]] with a screw-top helmet and brandished four [[mega-flame gun]]s, two [[needle-launcher]]s, and six [[boring-laser]]s in multiple pseudopodia. A [[Loudhailer/Legends|loudhailer]] incorporated into his suit amplified GrrKack's deep, mournful voice,<ref name="SH" /> although his mastery of the device was far from perfect. Like other Ugors, GrrKack hated [[Squib/Legends|Squibs]], considering them [[Demon/Legends|demons]] fit for little more than sacrifice to the [[Angel of Taxations and Imports]].<ref name="SH" />

==Behind the scenes==
GrrKack features as a minor antagonist in the adventure [[Scavenger Hunt (adventure)|''Scavenger Hunt'']], written by [[Brad Freeman]] and published by [[West End Games]] in [[1989]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. The Ugor meets the player characters when they enter the Paradise system and thus serves as their introduction to the Ugor species. Despite his fearsome appearance and arsenal of weaponry, the adventure indicates that the players should try to get past GrrKack and the other Ugors by negotiation with and cajoling rather than aggression.<ref name="SH" />
